convert-pdf-pages-to-bmp-with-font-subst.description: Loads a PDF, sets up a font substitution, binds the document with PdfConverter, configures resolution, and renders pages 2 and 3 to BMP images using BmpDevice.

convert-pdf-to-jpeg-images__v4.title: Convert PDF to JPEG Images with PdfConverter
convert-pdf-to-jpeg-images__v4.description: Shows how to load a PDF using PdfConverter, set a 96 dpi resolution, and export every page as a JPEG file.

convert-pdf-page-to-tiff.title: Convert Specific PDF Page to TIFF using PdfConverter
convert-pdf-page-to-tiff.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, binding it to PdfConverter, setting the page range to page 4, configuring form presentation mode to Production, and converting that page to a TIFF image.

convert-pdf-pages-to-gif__v11.title: Convert PDF Pages 1-5 to GIF Using PdfConverter
convert-pdf-pages-to-gif__v11.description: Shows how to load a PDF, bind it with PdfConverter, set the CropBox resolution to 72 DPI, and convert the first five pages into GIF images.

convert-pdf-pages-to-images-pdfconverter.title: Convert PDF Pages to Images Using PdfConverter
convert-pdf-pages-to-images-pdfconverter.description: Loads a PDF, binds it to Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfConverter, sets a page range (2‑5) and 144 DPI resolution, then converts the selected pages to image files (TIFF) and saves them.

convert-pdf-pages-6-10-to-bmp.title: Convert PDF Pages 6-10 to BMP Images
convert-pdf-pages-6-10-to-bmp.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with PdfConverter, selecting pages 6 through 10, and converting each page to BMP images using the default resolution.

convert-pdf-pages-to-jpeg__v9.title: Convert PDF Pages 1-12 to JPEG Images
convert-pdf-pages-to-jpeg__v9.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with PdfConverter, setting a page range (1‑12), and converting each page to a JPEG file using default settings.

convert-pdf-pages-to-high-quality-tiff__.title: Convert PDF Pages to High-Quality TIFF Images
convert-pdf-pages-to-high-quality-tiff__.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with PdfConverter, setting a 200 DPI resolution, and converting each page to separate high‑quality TIFF files.

convert-pdf-pages-to-png-with-font-mappi.title: Convert PDF Pages 3-6 to PNG with Custom Font Mapping
convert-pdf-pages-to-png-with-font-mappi.description: Shows how to load a PDF with PdfConverter, apply a custom font substitution, set rendering resolution, and convert pages 3 through 6 into PNG images using an intermediate TIFF file.

convert-pdf-pages-to-gif-with-font-subst.title: Convert PDF Pages 1-3 to GIF Images with Font Substitution
convert-pdf-pages-to-gif-with-font-subst.description: Loads a PDF, adds a font substitution, and uses PdfConverter to render pages 1‑3 as GIF images (via TIFF output).

convert-pdf-pages-to-bmp__v7.title: Convert PDF Pages to BMP Images with Specified Range and Resolution
convert-pdf-pages-to-bmp__v7.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with PdfConverter, setting a page range (2‑8) and 150 DPI resolution, then converting each page to a BMP file.

convert-pdf-pages-to-multi-page-tiff__v2.title: Convert PDF Pages 1-2 to Multi-Page TIFF with 300 DPI
convert-pdf-pages-to-multi-page-tiff__v2.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, binding it to PdfConverter, setting a 300 DPI resolution, and converting pages 1‑2 into a multi‑page TIFF image.

convert-pdf-pages-to-png-with-custom-fon.title: Convert PDF Pages 1-7 to PNG with Custom Font Support
convert-pdf-pages-to-png-with-custom-fon.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with PdfConverter, setting a page range (1‑7), registering a custom TrueType font, and converting each page to a PNG image.

convert-fdf-to-xml.title: Convert FDF File to XML
convert-fdf-to-xml.description: Demonstrates how to convert a single FDF file to XML using Aspose.Pdf's FormDataConverter and save the resulting XML locally.

convert-xml-to-fdf.title: Convert XML to FDF and Save Locally
convert-xml-to-fdf.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's FormDataConverter to transform an XML file into an FDF stream and write the result to a file on disk.

convert-fdf-to-xml__v2.title: Convert FDF File to XML using FormDataConverter
convert-fdf-to-xml__v2.description: Shows how to convert an FDF form data file into an XML representation by using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.FormDataConverter.

convert-xml-to-fdf__v2.title: Convert XML Form Data to FDF
convert-xml-to-fdf__v2.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.FormDataConverter to convert XML form data into an FDF file.

convert-multiple-fdf-to-xml.title: Convert Multiple FDF Files to XML Using FormDataConverter
convert-multiple-fdf-to-xml.description: Demonstrates how to batch‑convert all FDF files in a directory to XML files with matching filenames using Aspose.Pdf's FormDataConverter.

batch-convert-xml-to-fdf.title: Batch Convert XML to FDF Using FormDataConverter
batch-convert-xml-to-fdf.description: Demonstrates how to iterate over XML files in a folder and convert each one to an FDF file with the same base name using Aspose.Pdf's FormDataConverter.

batch-convert-fdf-to-xml.title: Batch Convert FDF Files to XML
batch-convert-fdf-to-xml.description: Demonstrates how to process all FDF files in a folder, converting each to an XML representation using Aspose.Pdf's FormDataConverter.

batch-convert-xml-to-fdf__v2.title: Batch Convert XML Form Data to FDF
batch-convert-xml-to-fdf__v2.description: Shows how to iterate over XML files in a folder and convert each to an FDF file using Aspose.Pdf's FormDataConverter static method.

convert-fdf-with-spaces-to-xml.title: Convert FDF File with Spaces to XML
convert-fdf-with-spaces-to-xml.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's FormDataConverter to convert an FDF file whose name contains spaces into an XML file, with proper stream handling via using blocks.

convert-unicode-xml-to-fdf.title: Convert Unicode XML to FDF with Form Facade
convert-unicode-xml-to-fdf.description: Demonstrates how to import an XML file containing Unicode characters into a PDF form and export it as an FDF file using Aspose.Pdf's Form facade while preserving the original encoding via streams.

convert-fdf-to-xml-with-formdataconverte.title: Convert FDF to XML with FormDataConverter
convert-fdf-to-xml-with-formdataconverte.description: Demonstrates how to read an FDF file and convert its contents to XML using Aspose.Pdf's FormDataConverter with FileStream handling, supporting file names that contain underscores and hyphens.

convert-xml-with-spaces-to-fdf.title: Convert XML Form Data with Spaces to FDF using Form Facade
convert-xml-with-spaces-to-fdf.description: Demonstrates how to handle file names containing spaces and use the Form facade to import XML form data and export it as an FDF file.

import-fdf-into-pdf-formdata-converter.title: Import FDF Data into PDF Using FormDataConverter
import-fdf-into-pdf-formdata-converter.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF template, open an FDF file from a read‑only directory with FileAccess.Read, import the form data using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form, and save the filled PDF.

convert-xml-to-fdf-with-directory-creati.title: Convert XML to FDF with Automatic Directory Creation
convert-xml-to-fdf-with-directory-creati.description: Demonstrates how to convert an XML file to an FDF file using Aspose.Pdf's FormDataConverter, creating the output directory if it does not already exist.

export-pdf-form-data-to-xml__v7.title: Export PDF Form Data to XML Using Form Facade
export-pdf-form-data-to-xml__v7.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF, export its form fields as XML, and save the result to a newly created subdirectory using FileMode.Create.

convert-xml-to-fdf-preserve-filename.title: Convert XML Form Data to FDF While Preserving Original Filename
convert-xml-to-fdf-preserve-filename.description: Shows how to load a PDF form, import XML data into it, and export the data as an FDF file, keeping the original XML filename by simply changing its extension to .fdf.

convert-fdf-to-xml-with-modified-filenam.title: Convert FDF to XML with Modified Filename
convert-fdf-to-xml-with-modified-filenam.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf's FormDataConverter to convert an FDF file to XML and save the output with a "_converted" suffix added before the .xml extension.

convert-xml-to-fdf-preserve-hierarchy.title: Convert XML to FDF While Preserving Folder Hierarchy
convert-xml-to-fdf-preserve-hierarchy.description: Demonstrates recursive conversion of XML form data files to FDF using Aspose.Pdf's FormDataConverter, mirroring the input directory structure in the output folder.

convert-fdf-to-xml-preserve-hierarchy.title: Convert FDF Files to XML While Preserving Folder Hierarchy
convert-fdf-to-xml-preserve-hierarchy.description: Demonstrates recursively locating FDF files, converting each to XML with FormDataConverter, and writing the output to a mirrored directory structure.

convert-fdf-to-xml__v3.title: Convert FDF to XML using FormDataConverter
convert-fdf-to-xml__v3.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.FormDataConverter to transform an FDF file into an XML document.

convert-xml-to-fdf__v3.title: Convert XML to FDF using FormDataConverter
convert-xml-to-fdf__v3.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.FormDataConverter to transform an XML file into an FDF file.

convert-dated-fdf-to-xml.title: Convert Dated FDF Files to XML with FormDataConverter
convert-dated-fdf-to-xml.description: The example scans an input folder for FDF files that contain a date stamp in their names, then uses Aspose.Pdf.Facades.FormDataConverter to transform each file into an XML document while preserving the original filename.

convert-fdf-to-xml-and-archive.title: Convert FDF to XML and Archive the Result
convert-fdf-to-xml-and-archive.description: Demonstrates converting an FDF file to XML using Aspose.Pdf's FormDataConverter and then moving the generated XML file to an archive folder.

convert-xml-to-fdf-and-archive.title: Convert XML to FDF and Archive the Result
convert-xml-to-fdf-and-archive.description: Demonstrates using FormDataConverter to transform an XML file into an FDF file and then move the generated file to an archive folder.

convert-fdf-to-xml-with-creation-date.title: Convert FDF to XML and Rename File with Creation Date
convert-fdf-to-xml-with-creation-date.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf's FormDataConverter to transform an FDF file into XML and then renames the resulting XML file to include the original file's creation timestamp.

convert-xml-to-fdf-rename-with-creation-.title: Convert XML to FDF and Rename with Creation Date
convert-xml-to-fdf-rename-with-creation-.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf's FormDataConverter to transform an XML file into an FDF file and then renames the output file to include the original XML's creation timestamp.

convert-fdf-to-xml__v4.title: Convert FDF Form Data to XML
convert-fdf-to-xml__v4.description: Demonstrates how to convert an FDF file containing form data into an XML file using Aspose.Pdf's FormDataConverter.

convert-xml-to-fdf__v4.title: Convert XML Form Data to FDF
convert-xml-to-fdf__v4.description: Shows how to read an XML file containing PDF form data and convert it to an FDF file using Aspose.Pdf's FormDataConverter.
